commands: bash -c 'if [ -x scripts/deploy-build.sh ]; then exec ./scripts/deploy-build.sh; else exec ./apps/heimdall/scripts/deploy-build.sh; fi'

deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'export HEIMDALL_REPO_ROOT="${HEIMDALL_REPO_ROOT:-$(pwd)}"; if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "\"workspaces\"" package.json 2>/dev/null; then cd apps/heimdall && exec bun run start; else exec bun run start; fi'
